text:
maria: re-requesting review on PR #4821 — addressed the rollback guard comments and added a small integration test. PTAL when you have a sec.

devin: looking now, thanks for the heads up

maria: main changes: moved the guard into request_router, tightened the invariants, and added a test simulating partial failure. also added a short note in the README about behavior during canary rollbacks.

jen: can you paste the smoke command? want to reproduce locally before approving

maria: sure — run the canary smoke locally:

```
./scripts/smoke.sh --pr 4821 --env canary --timeout 60
```

maria: CI is currently queued but the unit tests passed locally for me

ops-bot: CI status — check queued: build-4821 #25 (unit) — waiting for runner. expected ~3m delay

devin: quick glance at diff — looks good. a couple nits on logging lines but nothing blocking. will leave one minor comment.

alex: I left that logging suggestion, but the rollback guard logic LGTM. can we add a short comment on why we keep the backoff linear vs exp? small test would be fine.

maria: added comment and tiny test for backoff shape — pushed. rerunning smoke locally now and will wait for CI.

devin: thanks — once CI is green i'll +1 and we can schedule the merge in the afternoon window. any objections to merging after 2pm PT?

jen: fine by me, we have capacity in canary at 2:30

maria: great — tagging for merge ops. will watch canary and roll back if anything looks off :eyes:

ops-bot: CI status — build-4821 #25 (unit) — succeeded. build-4821 #26 (integration) — running

devin: marking as approved pending integration green :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — appreciate the quick eyes!
